use_case: mobile high-protein smoothie pop-up; 50g protein claim
lever: Already near the commodity WPC floor (~$30-34/kg in 20kg sacks). The real saving is reformulation: don't source all 50g protein from whey — milk (~8g/250ml), Greek yoghurt (~9-10g/100g) and PB (~7.5g/30g) contribute ~20-25g, so whey covers ~30g

recommended_suppliers.name: Professional Whey / Pure Product Australia / Bulk Nutrients (natural WPC 20kg)

caveats: WPI (isolate) costs more per kg; per-gram-protein advantage over WPC is small — stay WPC for cost
Reformulation moves the 50g claim to the finished blend, so lab substantiation must test the blend, not the scoop
next_action: Confirm SSD's 20kg sack price against Professional Whey, then redesign the recipe so whey supplies ~30g protein
